offering_description.value: Designs and sells network security hardware, software and cloud security services that protect enterprise, service provider and government networks from cyber threats. Products are built in-house and largely manufactured by contract partners, then sold through channel partners and delivered with ongoing subscriptions and support.

primary_products.value: network firewalls; network switches; wireless access points; endpoint security software; email security appliances; security information and event management software

primary_services.value: threat intelligence subscriptions; technical support; security training; professional services; managed security monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: enterprises, service providers, managed security providers, retailers, healthcare organizations; B2G: federal, state and local government agencies, defense and public sector bodies

end_markets.value: cybersecurity; telecommunications; government; financial services; healthcare; retail; education

revenue_model.value: product sales: firewall, switch and access point hardware and appliances; subscription: security services and threat intelligence subscriptions for devices and software; service fees: technical support, training and professional services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs hardware and sources manufacturing from contract partners, sold to channel partners and enterprises; software / platform: develops security operating systems, cloud platforms and threat intelligence services sold to customers

geography_served.value: global: sells in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: network security hardware, network access and switching, endpoint and email security, and security operations software sharing customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: value-added distributors that supply resellers and service providers; partners / resellers: channel partners, managed security providers and systems integrators who sell and deploy solutions; direct sales: direct sales teams serving large enterprise and government accounts; online: online store and cloud marketplaces for software and subscriptions
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: export controls and encryption import rules, plus data privacy and government security certification requirements
